description: Figure 3 is a pie chart illustrating the distribution of subtasks within the MMRA benchmark, with each slice representing a distinct subtask. The chart contains five labeled segments, each colored differently to distinguish the categories. The largest segment, colored dark blue, corresponds to the ObservationAngle (OA) task, accounting for 126 samples and 12.28% of the total. The second largest, in orange, represents the SubEvent (SubE) task, comprising 90 samples (8.78%). The third segment, green, is for the NearSameEntity task, with 80 samples (7.84%). The fourth, purple, is the SimilarMaterial task, with 75 samples (7.35%). The smallest segment, light blue, represents the LocatedNear task, with 65 samples (6.36%). The chart includes a legend that matches each color to its corresponding subtask label. Each slice also displays its sample count as an integer and its percentage in parentheses, providing a clear visual representation of the proportional contribution of each subtask to the overall benchmark.
